benefits.titleZh: 使用 CATCH 談論理解和潮流
benefits.titleEn: Use CATCH to talk about ideas and trends
benefits.zh: catch on 可以表示某人明白一件事，也可以表示一個新構思開始流行。
benefits.en: Catch on can show that a person understands something or that a new idea becomes popular.

benefits.titleEn: Talk clearly about distance and progress
benefits.zh: catch up 可以表示追上前面的人，也可以表示趕上其他人的水平。
benefits.en: Catch up can show someone reaching a person ahead or reaching the same level as other people.

benefits.titleZh: 談論未完成的事情和錯過的消息
benefits.titleEn: Talk about missed work and missing information
benefits.zh: 你可以 catch up on 未完成的工作，也可以 catch somebody up on 某人錯過的消息。
benefits.en: You can catch up on unfinished work or catch somebody up on news they have missed.

benefits.titleZh: 描述意外、錯誤和後來出現的後果
benefits.titleEn: Describe surprises, mistakes and later consequences
benefits.zh: catch somebody out 可以描述令人措手不及的困難或揭穿錯誤；catch up with somebody 則可以表示較早前的問題終於帶來影響。
benefits.en: Catch somebody out can describe an unexpected difficulty or reveal a mistake. Catch up with somebody can show that an earlier problem is finally having an effect.

referenceBank.meaningZh: 使某人措手不及或陷入困難；揭穿某人；誘使某人出錯
referenceBank.exampleEn: The sudden question caught him out.
referenceBank.exampleZh: 那條突然提出的問題令他措手不及。

referenceBank.meaningZh: 告訴某人最新情況；讓某人了解事情的進展
referenceBank.exampleEn: I caught Leo up on the class news.
referenceBank.exampleZh: 我告訴里奧班上的最新消息。

referenceBank.formula: catch up with somebody/something catch somebody/something up
referenceBank.meaningZh: 加快速度追上前面的人或事物
referenceBank.exampleEn: I ran faster and caught up with Eva.
referenceBank.exampleZh: 我跑得更快，追上了伊娃。

referenceBank.formula: catch up with somebody/something catch somebody/something up
referenceBank.meaningZh: 趕上某人或某事物的程度、質素或水平
referenceBank.exampleEn: Nia worked hard to catch up with her class.
referenceBank.exampleZh: 妮亞努力學習，以趕上全班的水平。

referenceBank.meaningZh: 補做之前未完成或未有時間做的事情
referenceBank.exampleEn: I stayed home to catch up on my homework.

referenceBank.formula: catch up catch up on something catch up with something
referenceBank.meaningZh: 了解或談論最近發生的事情
referenceBank.exampleEn: We met to catch up on each other’s news.
referenceBank.exampleZh: 我們見面了解並談論彼此的近況。

referenceBank.meaningZh: 過去的問題、壓力或錯誤終於開始帶來後果；警方或法律最終找到並懲罰某人
referenceBank.exampleEn: Too little sleep soon caught up with him.
referenceBank.exampleZh: 睡眠不足很快便開始對他造成影響。
